profile.name: Robotiq 三指自适应机械夹爪
profile.description: 这是一种安装在机器人末端的电动三指自适应夹爪，可通过位置、速度、力度和不同抓取模式控制手指运动，以夹持形状各异的工件。它常用于实验室自动化和机器人系统中的样品、器件或治具的抓取、搬运与定位。
profile.description_en: This is an electric three-finger adaptive robot gripper mounted on a robotic end effector. Its fingers can be controlled by position, speed, force, and grasping mode to handle objects of different shapes. It is commonly used in laboratory automation and robotic systems for grasping, transferring, and positioning samples, parts, or fixtures.
